type: 3x3 Series of Dynastic and Temporal Portraits
goal: Generate a 3×3 grid featuring the same fictional Chinese female character, with each panel displaying half-length portraits in different era costumes and backgrounds, suitable for cultural creative timelines or long image storyboard references.

subject.description: A fictional Chinese female subject around 30 years old, with deep brown to black long hair (can be styled up, tied, or curled according to the trend), oval face, warm light to medium skin tone, deep brown eyes, soft and natural eyebrows, defined features with subtle lines, typical Eastern bone structure (straight nose ridge, not overly three-dimensional facial structure); overall temperament is gentle and restrained, with a sense of understated Eastern aesthetics
subject.consistency: The nine squares feature the same person: facial proportions, bone structure, skin color, and temperament remain consistent, with only hairstyles, clothing, and accessories changing according to the era.

style: High resolution semi-realistic oil paint + digital retouching, each grid has slight era-corresponding paper or silk color texture edges, but the overall light source is soft studio shots with uniform white balance tendency

layout.gap: 1px light gray line separation, corner rounded 8px feel

panels.scenario: Han Dynasty: cross-collar deep robe, simplified hairpin, sitting on the ground with a background of bamboo slips and a low table.
Tang style: high bun with chest-length top, draped cloak, screen with lotus pattern at the back
Song system: Mandarin gown, pearl makeup, study window lattice and plum blossom vase
Yuan system: Simplified version of aunt's crown, robe, prairie dome drapery virtual scene
Ming style: stand collar long gown, horse front skirt, garden leakage window
Qing style: flag dress uniform, one ear hanging three pearls, virtual scenery of inner court columns
Republic of China: wavy short hair and standing collar short coat, holding a rattan box, with a calendar painting background
Early Nation Building: Gray-Blue Zhongshan Suit, Canvas Shoulder Bag, Collective Playground with Blurred Red Flag in the Background
Modern: cream white cover-up, wireless earbuds hanging neck, glass curtain wall urban night scenery blurred

must_keep: Nine frames must represent the same fictional character; 'similar but not' is not allowed.
Apparel elements respect common sense and do not mix serious errors
The gaze in each grid should naturally look outside the picture or slightly sideways, avoiding the copy-paste feel of the same angle in nine grids
avoid: Draw the character as different races or ages
Grid lines thicker than 2% of border width.
Deliberately close to the physical details of any specific real public figure
